C3 - Component View of Station 1 Registration. Mirrors the actual code in the registration-service module.
Component View: Slaughterhouse System - Station 1 - Registration
Owns the registered animals and Station
1's outbox. The station has its own store,
so a registration can be accepted without
any other part of the system being
Operator user interface. Logging in as
decides what is shown. Calls the stations'
own REST APIs and the traceability gRPC
service. Not required by the assignment.
Carries the stations' events to the
routes each event by its routing key to
tray, part and product. Queues and
required lookups: one animal, all animals
arriving on a date, and all animals from an
origin. Without a filter it returns every
registered animal; the two filters cannot be
Turns domain exceptions into HTTP status
codes: 404 when the animal is unknown,
already in use, and 400 when the request
body fails validation or combines both
number that is already in use, and defaults
the arrival time when the caller leaves it
out. Writes the animal and the outbox
event in one transaction. Knows nothing
Derived queries for lookup by registration
number, by arrival date as a half-open
The registration service's own view of an
weight and origin. Created on registration;
the REST API currently exposes no update
Pending events waiting to be forwarded,
each with an event id, a type and a JSON
payload. Written in the same transaction
as the animal, so a registration can never
be stored without its event. An event
leaves the table only once the broker has
Every five seconds by default, sends up to
Stops at the first event the broker does not
confirm, so nothing is deleted before it is
safe and the order is kept. Timestamp ties
have no explicit ordering; no global station
Publishes the event payload to the broker's
topic exchange under the routing key
animal.registered. Waits for the broker to
confirm it, and counts a message the
broker accepted but could not route to any
queue as a failure too, so the event stays
in the outbox instead of being deleted.
